subject.title: fix(heartbeat): task prompts reach the model

question: Should embedded runs treat every non-empty transcript substitution that is absent from the effective prompt as persistence-only, allowing the effective prompt to reach hooks and the model?
rationale: The heartbeat result is correct and proven, but the implementation deliberately changes a shared model/transcript fallback rather than special-casing heartbeat behavior, so permanent compatibility intent belongs to the prompt-boundary owner.

options.title: Accept the generic invariant
options.body: Merge after current-head checks, making distinct transcript substitutions persistence-only throughout the embedded runner.

options.title: Narrow the repair
options.body: Require a heartbeat-specific signal or typed prompt role if other callers rely on a distinct transcript substitution also replacing model-visible text.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic invariant
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head checks, making distinct transcript substitutions persistence-only throughout the embedded runner.
